label: preparing
what: A private celebration of my fortieth anniversary as mayor, apparently in the great hall at eighteen today. The innkeeper's withdrawn request and accepted invitation, and secretary's report of plans for two hundred loaves and eight lanterns with private payment being checked, strongly support coordinated preparations. The baker and innkeeper were reported together at the bakery. Secretary is knowingly assisting with confirmation and payment checks. Neighbour knows of the anniversary, but involvement in organizing it is not established; nor is Freight's knowing involvement, despite the baker seeking wheat.
